summary: $15-38 confirmed; the note's stale $22/$13 removed; count none -> 51, max rig 80 and pull-through added; 2-night weekend / 3-night holiday min and 14-night max, showers, dump, Checkfront booking added.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored 'lakeview' left; possible upgrade for the audit. County map puts sites 38, 39 and 47-50 on the row nearest the lake; imagery shows them about 30-60 m from the shore, across a paved lakeside trail and an open grassy bank with some trees. The site's own page says 'Beautiful View of Lake'. No site is at the water's edge; whether that apron earns more is the gate's call.
RATE PAGE: the $15-38 span is the county's only figure; site-by-date rates sit behind Checkfront, which I did not read. Note's $22/$13 did not match and was removed.
AMPS: page says only 'Electric Hookups' and frost-free hydrants; hookups group left unset.
SEASON: page does not state dates; the shower house is marked 'Open All Year'. Left unset.
PUBLIC: ordinary night is bookable by anyone. Pin good: on the camp road between the gate and the loops.
